words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 我每天早上都做半个小时运动。(Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang dōu zuò bàn gè xiǎoshí yùndòng.) — I exercise for half an hour every morning.
他喜欢在公园里跑步。(Tā xǐhuan zài gōngyuán lǐ pǎobù.) — He likes jogging in the park.

words.English Meaning: to take a walk / to stroll
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 晚饭后我们一起去散步吧。(Wǎnfàn hòu wǒmen yìqǐ qù sànbù ba.) — Let's go for a walk together after dinner.
夏天很多人喜欢去海边游泳。(Xiàtiān hěn duō rén xǐhuan qù hǎibiān yóuyǒng.) — In summer many people like to go swimming at the beach.
周末我们常去KTV唱歌。(Zhōumò wǒmen cháng qù KTV chànggē.) — We often go singing at KTV on weekends.
她在广场上跟着音乐跳舞。(Tā zài guǎngchǎng shang gēnzhe yīnyuè tiàowǔ.) — She dances along to the music in the square.
今年假期你打算去哪里旅游？(Jīnnián jiàqī nǐ dǎsuàn qù nǎlǐ lǚyóu?) — Where do you plan to travel for holiday this year?

words.English Meaning: to take photos / to snap pictures
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 这里的风景太美了，快拍照！(Zhèlǐ de fēngjǐng tài měi le, kuài pāizhào!) — The scenery here is gorgeous, hurry take a photo!
今晚你想看什么电影？(Jīnwǎn nǐ xiǎng kàn shénme diànyǐng?) — What movie do you want to watch tonight?

words.English Meaning: to play / to hang out / to have fun
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 周末欢迎来我家玩！(Zhōumò huānyíng lái wǒ jiā wán!) — Welcome to come over to my place to hang out this weekend!

words.English Meaning: to go online / surf the internet
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 他在上网查学习资料。(Tā zài shàngwǎng chá xuéxí zīliào.) — He is going online to look up study materials.
我们一边喝咖啡一边聊天。(Wǒmen yìbiān hē kāfēi yìbiān liáotiān.) — We drank coffee while chatting.
我做家务时喜欢听轻音乐。(Wǒ zuò jiāwù shí xǐhuan tīng qīng yīnyuè.) — I like listening to light music when doing chores.
经常锻炼身体对健康有好处。(Jīngcháng duànliàn shēntǐ duì jiànkāng yǒu hǎochu.) — Regular exercise is good for health.

words.English Meaning: to go window shopping / stroll the streets
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 星期六我和朋友去市中心逛街。(Xīngqīliù wǒ hé péngyou qù shìzhōngxīn guàngjiē.) — On Saturday I went window shopping downtown with friends.
今晚我们有一个老同学聚会。(Jīnwǎn wǒmen yǒu yí gè lǎo tóngxué jùhuì.) — We have a reunion party with old classmates tonight.
下午我们去体育馆打球吧。(Xiàwǔ wǒmen qù tǐyùguǎn dǎqiú ba.) — Let's go play ball at the gymnasium this afternoon.
天气好时我喜欢骑车上班。(Tiānqì hǎo shí wǒ xǐhuan qíchē shàngbān.) — When the weather is nice I like riding a bike to work.

words.English Meaning: to climb a mountain / to hike
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 秋天是去郊外爬山的好季节。(Qiūtiān shì qù jiāowài páshān de hǎo jìjié.) — Autumn is a great season to hike in the countryside.
你的主要业余爱好是什么？(Nǐ de zhǔyào yèyú àihào shì shénme?) — What is your main hobby in your spare time?
听音乐能帮我放松心情。(Tīng yīnyuè néng bāng wǒ fàngsōng xīnqíng.) — Listening to music helps me relax.
早睡早起是一个好习惯。(Zǎoshuì zǎoqǐ shì yí gè hǎo xíguàn.) — Sleeping early and getting up early is a good habit.
祝你周末过得愉快！(Zhù nǐ zhōumò guò de yúkuài!) — Wish you a pleasant weekend!
毕业后你有什么打算？(Bìyè hòu nǐ yǒu shénme dǎsuan?) — What are your plans after graduation?
他经常去图书馆借书。(Tā jīngcháng qù túshūguǎn jiè shū.) — He often goes to the library to borrow books.
